question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dune, Bob gets Candide, and Claire gets Walden.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Claire and Alice swap books. Finally, Alice and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Dune
(B) Candide
(C) Walden
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (Dune, Candide, Walden)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (Candide, Dune, Walden)
2. Claire and Alice swap: (Walden, Dune, Candide)
3. Alice and Bob swap: (Dune, Walden, Candide)
Claire has Candide, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
